representativeSnapshot.kind: Supabase project with promoter Phases 1-9 applied

rowCountQueries: promoter table grants/policies and existing Security Advisor findings
preflight.expectedAffectedRows: Creates empty risk-event and privacy-minimized operational telemetry tables; adds deny policies and no backfill.

execution.resumeStrategy: Expand-only, idempotent object creation and function replacement. No destructive backfill is performed.
execution.idempotency: Risk transitions lock one flag and append an immutable event. Operational telemetry is best-effort and never blocks financial work.

quarantine.strategy: Disable the relevant feature flag; preserve all financial, risk, and telemetry history for forward repair.

constraints: direct authenticated access is explicitly denied on sensitive promoter tables
risk and telemetry metadata reject sensitive identifiers
privileged risk and readiness functions are service_role only
indexes: operational events by event/time and organization/type/time
constraintsAndIndexes.validationPlan: Run the RLS regression SQL, admin persona matrix, allocation concurrency test, refund/reversal reconciliation, risk hold exclusion, failed batch retry, CSV export, and advisor review.

recovery.forwardFix: Use additive policy/function changes and document any advisor exception.

queries: review RLS policy inventory and grants
confirm readiness RPC reports manual-only payouts
